## About
Pike Collision Center is an auto body and frame shop at 6405 Massachusetts Ave in Indianapolis. Harry Hults Sr. and Harry Hults Jr. bring a lot of years in body work and painting to every job.
We handle collision, frame, body and hail damage repair, plus custom paint with expert color matching, mechanic work and routine maintenance. We work on all years, makes and models, and on boats, bikes and trailers too.
We work for the customer, not the insurance company, and we work with all insurance companies. We also give back, donating to groups like Toys for Tots, Special Olympics, St. Jude and the Wounded Warrior Project.

## Services
- Collision repair: One reviewer recommends Pike Collision to anyone who needs collision repair.
- Frame and body work: Frame and body work alongside hail dent repair.
- Hail damage repair: Hail dent repair done without drilling holes in your car.
- Custom paint and color matching: Custom paint work with expert color matching.
- Custom metal work: One reviewer's Jeep got a custom metal plate welded onto a rusted quarter panel so the bumper cover could go back on.
- Mechanic work and routine maintenance: Mechanic work and routine maintenance in addition to collision work.
- Boats, bikes and trailers: We work on more than cars, including boats, bikes and trailers.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies, and you can choose us even if your insurer suggests another shop.

Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Estimates are free.

Q: Do your repairs come with a warranty?
A: Yes. There is a lifetime warranty on all repairs, except rust.

## What customers say
- "Harry at Pike Collision did a great job repairing my Jeep. He took the time to really look over the repair and gave me honest advice on the best way to fix it. The quarter panel was badly rusted and the cover that came with my bumper had fallen off because there was nothing solid left to attach it to.

Harry did custom work by making a metal plate and welding it onto the quarter panel so the cover could be installed correctly again. The repair turned out solid and exactly what I needed.

Great work, fair advice, and I would definitely recommend Pike Collision to anyone needing collision repair." (Brent Harris, 5/5)
